text:
olivia: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem re: recurring long-context spikes. Need clear SLO updates, owners, and short-term mitigations.

sam: Summary: bursts of >2k-token requests are creating batching backpressure and starving small requests. p99 latency jumped to ~1.9s for ~6 minutes.

harper: I propose a temporary SLO window change so on-call doesn't get paged for transient tail while we deploy batching fixes. Also need dashboards for token-size distribution + queue depth.

infra-lead: We can temporarily relax p99 but document rollback criteria. Don't change p95. Also require a migration plan for the batching scheduler fix with a canary.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-368 | Sev2 | start=2174197800 | end=2174201400 | link=https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-368

olivia: Draft SLO tweak (short-term): p95 <= 240ms (30d), p99 <= 1.0s (14d review). Rationale: keeps product SLAs intact while we patch scheduler.

sam: Action items: - sam: PR SLO change + rollback criteria (due 2026-04-08) - harper: dashboard + alerts (token hist, per-instance queue depth, kv-cache miss) (due 2026-04-07) - infra-lead: schedule canary for batching-scheduler patch and perf targets (due 2026-04-12)

harper: I'll add alerts: sustained p99 > 950ms for 3m -> page; queue_depth > 120 for 2m -> warn; kv_cache_miss > 25% for 5m -> channel. Will include playbook links.

sam: We should also trial a dynamic fallback: route requests > 1024 tokens to compact-quant during high queue depth. Prototype in dev next 48h.

infra-lead: Approved prototype. Perf tests mandatory before rollout. Also add automated rollback if error rates increase > 2% in canary.

olivia: Noted. I'll update the postmortem action tracker and create a recurring 2-week "long-context review" until metrics stable for 30 days.

harper: Opening dashboard PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/771

sam: Opening SLO PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/slo-config/pull/499

olivia: Thanks everyone. We'll sync on the canary before infra lead's rollout date. If owners need to shift deadlines, drop updates here. :thumbsup:
